{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2026 Ohio state treasurer election''' is scheduled to take place on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[State Treasurer of Ohio|state treasurer of Ohio]]. Incumbent [[Republican Party of Ohio|Republican]] State Treasurer [[Robert Sprague]] is term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election, and is running for [[2026 Ohio Secretary of State election|secretary of state]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Republican Ohio Treasurer Robert Sprague enters 2026 GOP primary for Secretary of State |url=https://ohiocapitaljournal.com/briefs/ohio-republican-treasurer-robert-sprague-enters-2026-gop-primary-for-secretary-of-state/ |publisher=[[Ohio Capital Journal]] |access-date=20 July 2025 |date=5 February 2025}}</ref> Primary elections were held on May 5.
